envelope.description: Expose park and resume as workflow-step phases and daemon operations

body.title: Expose park and resume as workflow-step phases and daemon operations
body.summary: Add the park and resume phases to the workflow-step input and output types, the dispatcher in src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/handler.ts (and its unknown-phase message) and new phase handlers that call parkDraft and resumeStage and map TeamGateRefusedError to team-gate-refused; register the team.park and team.resume operations in the daemon handler map beside repo.add.
acceptanceChecks: The park and resume phases reach the run store and return the park result or the next workflow turn
team.park and team.resume return the same results over the daemon operation
A refusal by the gate comes back as team-gate-refused naming the holder

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/__tests__/handoff-phases.test.ts: the park and resume phases and the team.park and team.resume operations reach the run store, return the park result or the next turn, and map a gate refusal to team-gate-refused
